name: [Update Mod]: Madrid Transit Pack
author: xoaninc
description: Standardized Madrid train types, one per real network: Metro narrow-profile (CAF S/3000, lines 1-5 and the Ramal), Metro wide-profile (S/8000-9000, lines 6-12), Metro Ligero (Citadis 302) and Cercanías Madrid (S/452 Alstom X'Trapolis). Real-world specs from official technical documentation and as-built project records: curve radii down to 90 m on the historic narrow-profile lines and 250 m on the wide-profile network, and gradients set to what the network actually climbs rather than the 3.5% design criterion — 5.2% narrow-profile (the Ramal Ópera–Príncipe Pío runs at 52.06‰ in commercial service) and 4% wide-profile (the L7 extension to Pitis under the M-30, the L8–L10 link, L9 Pavones–Puerta de Arganda). Real platform lengths (60-115 m), narrow-profile tunnels are cheaper to bore, and 140 km/h high-capacity commuter EMUs with 100/200 m consists. Maintenance costs sit at parity with the vanilla train types. One type per network (instead of per-model) means branches and shared tracks between lines of the same network are fully compatible. Cercanías stats derived from DanielD1909's danTrains (MIT), verified against the real S/452 specs. Full sources in the README.
